description: Export a cluster backup to Object Storage (POST …/backups/{backupName}/export → 202 Operation). Requires an Object Storage subscription. 409 if the same backup is already being exported or is IN_USE.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

uploadPath.description: Path inside the bucket (default root, e.g. backups/2026)

name: ncloud_serverless_export_backup
